{{ill|Kofun|en|Kofun|WD=Q1141225|lt=Kofun|1=Kofun}} located in Somanouchi Town, {{ill|Tenri, Nara|en|Tenri, Nara|WD=Q502196|lt=Tenri|1=Tenri, Nara}}, {{ill|Nara Prefecture|en|Nara Prefecture|WD=Q131287|lt=Nara Prefecture|1=Nara Prefecture}}, Japan. It is Historic Site1 as a National Historic Site and is part of the {{ill|Somanouchi Kofun cluster|en|Somanouchi Kofun cluster|WD=Q11523653|lt=Somanouchi Kofun cluster|1=Somanouchi Kofun cluster}}. == Overview == Constructed during the early {{ill|Kofun period|en|Kofun period|WD=Q459939|lt=Kofun period|1=Kofun period}} (4th century), Nishiyama Kofun is the oldest of the {{ill|Somanouchi Kofun cluster|en|Somanouchi Kofun cluster|WD=Q11523653|lt=Somanouchi Kofun cluster|1=Somanouchi Kofun cluster}}. The Kofun features a unique combination of construction styles, transitioning from a {{ill|zenpō-kōhō-fun|ja|前方後方墳|lt=Zenpō-kōhō-fun|1=Zenpō-kōhō-fun|comment=doing this because I need to differentiate it in piped links too with my new interwiki tool as not the ambiguous phrase keyhole shaped kofun|1=zenpō-kōhō-fun|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/zenpō-kōhō-fun|13=User:Immanuelle/zenpō-kōhō-fun|comment=enwiki is a redirect}} at its base to a {{ill|Zenpō-kōen-fun|en|Zenpō-kōen-fun|WD=Q11268718|lt=Zenpō-kōen-fun|1=Zenpō-kōen-fun}} at its upper levels. The tomb was partially disturbed during WWII when it was repurposed for anti-aircraft defense. Evidence of looting suggests that its burial chamber, constructed from stone sourced from Kashiwabara (present-day {{ill|Kashiwara|en|Kashiwara|WD=Q873583|lt=Kashiwara|1=Kashiwara}}), was targeted. == area and burial == The tumulus measures 183 meters in length and features a three-tiered construction: * '''Rear mound (posterior):''' 94m width, 16m height * '''Anterior mound:''' 72m width, 13m height The lower tier types a classic {{ill|zenpō-kōhō-fun|ja|前方後方墳|lt=Zenpō-kōhō-fun|1=Zenpō-kōhō-fun|comment=doing this because I need to differentiate it in piped links too with my new interwiki tool as not the ambiguous phrase keyhole shaped kofun|1=zenpō-kōhō-fun|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/zenpō-kōhō-fun|13=User:Immanuelle/zenpō-kōhō-fun|comment=enwiki is a redirect}} with a square posterior mound (90m sides) and a matching anterior mound. The middle and upper tiers, however, resemble a {{ill|Zenpō-kōen-fun|en|Zenpō-kōen-fun|WD=Q11268718|lt=Zenpō-kōen-fun|1=Zenpō-kōen-fun}} with a circular posterior section (72m diameter) and a narrower anterior projection. The posterior mound height reaches 15 meters, while the anterior mound height is 10 meters. Surrounding the tumulus was a stepped moat system, now mostly filled in. Nishiyama Kofun is the largest example of its type in Japan. Its combination of construction styles is believed to be intentional, reflecting a transitional phase in kofun design. == burial goods == Excavations have yielded: * '''Posterior mound:''' ** ''' Mirror fragments''' ** '''Greenstone arrowheads''' ** '''Magatama beads''' ** '''Iron sword fragments''' * '''Moat (south side):''' ** ''' Greenstone wheel stones''' * '''Surface burial goods:''' ** ''' Stone paving (fukiishi)''' ** '''Haniwa fragments (cylindrical, finned, house-shaped)''' == Current State == The tumulus is well-preserved, with no significant vegetation on its surface, allowing clear observation of its tiered structure. == Access == * 20 minutes on foot from Tenri Station. * Located 500 meters south of the {{ill|Tenri University Sankōkan Museum|en|Tenri University Sankōkan Museum|WD=Q17229261|lt=Tenri University Sankokan Museum|1=Tenri University Sankōkan Museum}} and adjacent to Tenri Junior High School. == Cultural Significance == === National Historic Site === * Designated on April 8, 1927{{国cultural property等データベース|401|1958|西山古墳}}. * In 2018, Nishinorikura Kofun was added to the Historic Site1 area, renaming the site "Somanouchi Kofun Group."Ministry of Education, Culture, Sports, Science and Technology Notice No. 19, February 13, 2018. == References == {{reflist}} == See Also == * {{ill|Somanouchi Kofun cluster|en|Somanouchi Kofun cluster|WD=Q11523653|lt=Somanouchi Kofun cluster|1=Somanouchi Kofun cluster}} == External Links == * {{国cultural property等データベース|401|1958|西山古墳}} * [http://www.city.tenri.nara.jp/kanko/kohun_guide/kohun/index.html Tenri City Kofun Guide] {{otheruses|Nishiyama Kofun in Tenri, Nara|Nishiyama Kofun in Ota, Gunma|Nishiyama Kofun (Ota)}} {{Infobox ancient site | name = Nishiyama Kofun | native_name = 西山古墳 | image = [[File:Nishiyama Kofun, zenkei-1.jpg|280px]]

{{National Aerial Photography}}.

Its area are: * '''Total length''': 183 meters * '''Rear section''' (square): 94m wide × 16m high * '''Front section''': 72m wide The '''lower level''' is '''rectangular''', while the '''middle and upper levels''' are '''rounder''', creating a hybrid '''keyhole-shaped mound (前方後円形, zenpō-kōenkei)'''. The '''central burial chamber''' is estimated to be a '''[[Vertical Pit-Style Stone Chamber|pit-style stone chamber]]''' based on '''historical records'''. A '''moat once surrounded the mound''', but it has since been '''filled in'''. This kofun is '''the largest of its kind in Japan'''. The '''unique construction''', with a '''rectangular lower tier supporting a rounder upper structure''', is believed to be '''original to its design'''. == burial goods & burial Goods == Excavations have uncovered: * '''Copper mirrors (fragments)''' * '''Green jasper arrowheads''' * '''Magatama beads''' * '''Iron swords and blades''' * '''Wheel-shaped stone object (碧玉製車輪石, hekigyoku-sei sharinseki)''' * '''Haniwa clay figures''', including: ** '''[[Cylindrical Haniwa|Cylindrical haniwa]] (円筒埴輪)''' ** '''Fin-shaped haniwa (鰭付円筒埴輪)''' ** '''[[Representational Haniwa|House-shaped haniwa]] (家形埴輪)''' == Current Condition == The '''mound is well preserved''', and due to '''lack of tree cover''', the '''three-tiered structure is clearly visible'''. == Access == * '''20-minute walk from {{ill|Tenri Station|en|Tenri Station|WD=Q4188394|lt=Tenri Station|1=Tenri Station}}''' - The mound is positioned '''along three natural ridges''', with the '''central ridge typeing the main mound''', while the '''north and south ridges serve as outer embankments'''. A '''moat once surrounded the mound''', but it has since been '''filled in'''. This kofun is '''the largest of its kind in Japan'''. The '''unique construction''', with a '''rectangular lower tier supporting a rounder upper structure''', is believed to be '''original to its design'''. == burial goods & burial Goods == Excavations have uncovered: * '''Copper mirrors (fragments)''' * '''Green jasper arrowheads''' * '''Magatama beads''' * '''Iron swords and blades''' * '''Wheel-shaped stone object (碧玉製車輪石, hekigyoku-sei sharinseki)''' * '''Haniwa clay figures''', including: ** '''[[Cylindrical Haniwa|Cylindrical haniwa]] (円筒埴輪)''' ** '''Fin-shaped haniwa (鰭付円筒埴輪)''' ** '''[[Representational Haniwa|House-shaped haniwa]] (家形埴輪)''' == Current Condition == The '''mound is well preserved''', and due to '''lack of tree cover''', the '''three-tiered structure is clearly visible'''. == Access == * '''20-minute walk from {{ill|Tenri Station|en|Tenri Station|WD=Q4188394|lt=Tenri Station|1=Tenri Station}}''' - Located '''500 meters south''' of the '''Tenri University Reference Museum''' * '''Just north''' of '''Tenri Middle School''' == designation1 == === '''National Historic Site of Japan''' === * '''Original Historic Site (1927)''': Nishiyama Kofun was Historic Site1 a '''National Historic Site'''. * '''Expansion (2018)''': The Historic Site was '''expanded''' to include '''Nishinorikura Kofun (西乗鞍古墳)''', renaming the site as the '''Somanochi Kofun Group (杣之内古墳群)'''.Ministry of Education, Science and Culture Announcement No. 19 (February 13, 2018). == References == {{Reflist}} == Additional Resources == * '''On-site intypeation board''' (Tenri City Board of Education) * '''Tenri City Website: Kofun Guide''' == Related Articles == * {{ill|Somanouchi Kofun cluster|en|Somanouchi Kofun cluster|WD=Q11523653|lt=Somanouchi Kofun cluster|1=Somanouchi Kofun cluster}} == External Links == {{Commonscat|Nishiyama Kofun}} * [https://kunishitei.bunka.go.jp/heritage/detail/401/1958 '''Agency for Cultural Affairs (Japan): Nishiyama Kofun'''] * [http://www.city.tenri.nara.jp/kanko/kohun_guide/kohun/index.html '''Tenri City Official Kofun Guide'''] {{Kofun navbar}} {{translated page|ja|西山古墳|version=96134985|comment=Imported full ja history}} {{Commons category|Nishiyama Kofun}} {{wikidata link|Q11627818|co|commons:Category:Nishiyama Kofun|ja|西山古墳|zh|三角縁神獣鏡が確認された主な古墳|ja|宮谷古墳|ja|徳島市|ja|那珂八幡古墳|ja|福岡市|ja|石塚山古墳|ja|京都郡|ja|一貴山銚子塚古墳|ja|糸島市|ja|岩上祭祀遺構|ja|宗像市|ja|赤塚古墳|ja|宇佐市|ja|川部・高森古墳群|ja|持田古墳群|ja|児湯郡|ja|高鍋町}} [[Category:Archaeological sites in Japan]] [[Category:Kofun of Nara prefecture]] [[Category:National historic sites in Nara prefecture]] [[Category:Pages using infobox ancient site with unknown parameters]] [[Category:Somanouchi Kofun cluster]] [[Category:Wikidata has short description]] [[Category:Zenpō-kōhō-fun]] [[Category:Pages with interwikis with duplicate languages]]
